title: The Queen Was the Bait
setup: Black has just captured your queen, the kind of capture nobody stops to look at, and you have one move.
hint: The black king has only one free square. Give a check that drives it there, and make sure your other bishop can reach that square's diagonal.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxf7+}} offers a second piece to a king with nowhere to run. The king cannot take on f7, because the knight on e5 defends it, so {{Ke7}} is forced. Then {{Bg5#}}: the bishop from c1 checks along the diagonal through e7, and every square around the king is covered or blocked.

A knight, two bishops and no queen finish the game on move eight.

A queued capture fires into whatever position arrives. Premove the safe move, never the greedy capture.
